phases.description: Demonstrate accessible mobile journeys and a persistent 40-plot household/season model.
phases.label: PHASE 1
phases.name: Experience and foundation

phases.description: A verified household signs in with an emailed link and applies for the coming season.
phases.label: PHASE 2
phases.name: Authenticated applications

phases.description: Coordinator assigns plots with returning priority and strict FIFO; gardeners see their own allocation.
phases.label: PHASE 3
phases.name: Fair allocation

phases.description: Gardeners report plot problems; coordinator resolves them and receives a daily digest.
phases.label: PHASE 4
phases.name: Problems and notifications

phases.description: Demonstrate and accept requirements 1–4, passwordless access and daily notifications with operational evidence.
phases.label: PHASE 5
phases.name: First-version release

phases.description: Coordinator sees a responsive accessible grid of all 40 plots and their holders.
phases.label: PHASE 6
phases.name: After first version: plot map
